schema_version: v0 — skill-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The discovery surface — list every installed Cairn skill with its name and one-line description, so 'what can I ask you to do?' has a measured answer.
why: A system whose entry points are invisible is a system whose entry points go unused. The skill roster is a record of truth (node_classes/skill.json members_so_far); this renders it at human tempo, read-only, no gates.
how_it_learns: It does not — by design. The skill list is derived on read from the installed SKILL.md files; the learning is in the skills themselves, not in the listing.
traces_to: Law 5 (intent and proofs share an address — each skill's SKILL.md carries its own description at its own address)
Law 1 (the resolver is spent on the novel — a discoverable roster means nobody re-derives which skills exist)
learns: It does not; it is a reference display — it renders help text without learning.
